## The rows

- **ARC-004** · Everything personal lives in one place and comes away whole – Everything personal lives in one place, nowhere else, and comes away whole. · `dev/specs/system/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- **ARC-013** · All scratch output goes to one place that can vanish – All scratch output goes to one disposable location. · `dev/specs/system/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- **CON-021** · A long chat may say once that new chats remember – Once a chat has grown long enough to slow down, she may be told once, ever, at a calm moment, that a new chat is fine and still remembers everything. · `dev/specs/interaction/conduct.md`
- **CTX-001** · The always-loaded instructions stay under a measured size limit – The always-loaded instructions stay under a measured size limit. · `dev/specs/system/context.md`
- **DEP-014** · A copy is looked after for its whole life – A copy can be started, checked, changed, repaired, moved and retired from one conversation, each step starting from what the copy shows rather than from what anyone remembers. · `dev/specs/system/deployment.md`
- **DES-008** · Every view opens and responds without a wait anyone notices – Every view opens, and answers a tap, without a wait anyone notices. · `dev/specs/ux/design.md`
- **DEV-003** · A development reply takes whatever shape its moment needs most – A development reply takes the shape its moment needs. · `dev/specs/system/dev.md`
- **DEV-004** · A development reply fits the screen chosen for the chat – A development reply fits a phone, unless the developer chose wide for that chat. · `dev/specs/system/dev.md`
- **DEV-014** · A development chat finishes or drops its own work – A development chat finishes or drops its own work before it ends. · `dev/specs/system/dev.md`
- **HBT-006** · A heartbeat that is due runs, whether or not scheduled – A heartbeat that is due runs, whether or not anything schedules it. · `dev/specs/system/heartbeats.md`
- **HBT-008** · A failed heartbeat is known, and retried only so often – A heartbeat that failed is known to have failed, and is retried only so often. · `dev/specs/system/heartbeats.md`
- **HYG-003** · Repetition is found by a machine, not by eye – Repetition is found by a machine. · `dev/specs/system/hygiene.md`
- **HYG-006** · Code is kept current without changing what it does – An unattended run keeps the code in line with the best practice its listed sources state on the day it runs, and with the developer's own rules, landing a change only where the behaviour lock shows nothing the app does has changed and the speed check shows it no slower; a change it cannot show to be unchanged goes to the developer. · `dev/specs/system/hygiene.md`
- **PMM-006** · Procedures are re-checked on schedule, and sooner when anything shifts – Every procedure is re-checked against current practice at a set interval, and sooner when something it depends on changes, such as the model, a source, or a failure in use. An overdue procedure keeps running but is shown as due until the re-check is done and recorded, even when nothing changed. · `dev/specs/system/skills.md`
- **PMM-015** · A procedure stays small, loading only what the moment needs – A procedure is loaded only when it applies, never added to what is always loaded. It stays within size limits taken from current practice; when it outgrows one place it splits, so that each situation leads in one step to a single part that says when to read it. Splitting and routing are tested together, so a smaller procedure never reads the wrong part. · `dev/specs/system/skills.md`
- **SMP-007** · The invented record keeps pace with the real one – A fabricated record is kept current with the real one — in shape, and in time. · `dev/specs/data/sample.md`
- **WKB-010** · Development leaves the developer more capable, not just the harness – Development work leaves the developer more capable, not only the harness better. · `dev/specs/system/workbench.md`
